name: ptk_list_statuspages
description: Lists all configured status pages monitored by PTK with overall health indicators and active incident counts.

name: ptk_get_statuspage_details
description: Returns operational summary, status breakdown, degraded components, and active incidents for a specified StatusPage ID, name, or slug (e.g. "cloudflare").

statuspage_id.description: StatusPage identifier, name, or partial slug (e.g. "cloudflare").

include_all_components.description: Optional (default false). Set true to include a capped component sample in addition to degraded components.

name: ptk_list_incidents
description: Returns paginated incidents with update descriptions truncated to 180 characters. statuspage_id is optional: omit or pass 'all' to check ALL statuspages at once. Never guess placeholder IDs like 'statuspage-1'.

statuspage_id.description: Optional. Omit or pass 'all' to check ALL statuspages at once. Never guess placeholder IDs like 'statuspage-1'.

offset.description: Optional 0-based item offset (overrides page if provided).

name: ptk_get_incident_details
description: Returns full chronological update timeline and affected components for the specified incident.

statuspage_id.description: Optional StatusPage ID, name, or slug. Omit or pass "all" to search all monitored status pages.

name: ptk_ping
description: Runs unprivileged TCP/Socket latency checks to a destination host and port.

name: ptk_list_servers
description: Lists all monitored server endpoints in PTK with connection status and last ping latency.

name: ptk_get_server_telemetry
description: Returns scalar metrics for a specified server (CPU load/temp, RAM used/total, net throughput, uptime).

server_id.description: Server identifier, name, or partial hostname.
